svg.title: Base Case: $280,000 Fees to $84,000 Owner Net
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-03-base-case-fee-to-owner-profit; chart type: waterfall; title: Base Case: $280,000 Fees to $84,000 Owner Net; subtitle: Four expense deductions reconcile exactly to a 30.0% annual net margin.; chapter number: 3; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Annual USD. First and last bars are absolute totals; intervening bars are signed deductions. Expense allocation is illustrative; the canonical totals are $280,000 revenue, $196,000 expenses, and $84,000 owner net. Owner labor is supported by the residual rather than a second salary deduction.; caption: $280,000 - $100,000 - $48,000 - $24,000 - $24,000 = $84,000; $84,000 / $280,000 = 30.0%. Client principal and creditor remittances never enter the revenue bar.; stages: label: Recognized service fees; value: Annual earned operator fee revenue totals exactly $280,000; numeric value: 280000.0; detail: Opening total equals the canonical Base-Case revenue. Illustrative collections of $1,120,000 at a 25% service fee generate $280,000; the remaining creditor allocation is not operator revenue or an operator expense.; label: Contract delivery labor; value: Deduct $100,000 for nonowner research and recovery-administration delivery; numeric value: -100000.0; detail: Illustrative file-linked contractor expense covers research and administrative delivery, excluding separately budgeted outside counsel. Remaining contribution equals $180,000.; label: Counsel and enforcement; value: Deduct $48,000 for operator-borne legal work and execution expenses; numeric value: -48000.0; detail: Include only costs contractually borne by the operator. Do not duplicate creditor-funded advances as operator expenses. Remaining contribution equals $132,000.; label: Research and systems; value: Deduct $24,000 for lawful data, docket monitoring, and reconciliation systems; numeric value: -24000.0; detail: Illustrative recurring allocation equals $2,000 monthly. Maintain access permissions, source records, matter-level audit trails, and deadline alerts. Remaining contribution equals $108,000.; label: Operating overhead; value: Deduct $24,000 for insurance, bookkeeping, administration, and business overhead; numeric value: -24000.0; detail: Illustrative recurring allocation equals $2,000 monthly. Combined recurring systems and overhead equal $4,000 monthly, inside the $2,000–$12,000 planning range. File-linked delivery and enforcement costs remain additional.; label: Annual owner net; value: Closing annual owner net profit equals exactly $84,000; numeric value: 84000.0; detail: Closing total is not another cash inflow. The four-person Base pod is 1 FT + 3 C. Canonical comparison: Conservative $60,000 at 20% yields $12,000 with 1 FT + 3 C; Scaled $500,000 at 40% yields $200,000 with 2 FT + 4 C.

text.tspan: Base Case: $280,000 Fees to $84,000 Owner Net

circle.title: label: Recognized service fees; value: Annual earned operator fee revenue totals exactly $280,000; numeric value: 280000.0; detail: Opening total equals the canonical Base-Case revenue. Illustrative collections of $1,120,000 at a 25% service fee generate $280,000; the remaining creditor allocation is not operator revenue or an operator expense.

label: Contract delivery labor; value: Deduct $100,000 for nonowner research and recovery-administration delivery; numeric value: -100000.0; detail: Illustrative file-linked contractor expense covers research and administrative delivery, excluding separately budgeted outside counsel. Remaining contribution equals $180,000.

label: Counsel and enforcement; value: Deduct $48,000 for operator-borne legal work and execution expenses; numeric value: -48000.0; detail: Include only costs contractually borne by the operator. Do not duplicate creditor-funded advances as operator expenses. Remaining contribution equals $132,000.

label: Research and systems; value: Deduct $24,000 for lawful data, docket monitoring, and reconciliation systems; numeric value: -24000.0; detail: Illustrative recurring allocation equals $2,000 monthly. Maintain access permissions, source records, matter-level audit trails, and deadline alerts. Remaining contribution equals $108,000.

label: Operating overhead; value: Deduct $24,000 for insurance, bookkeeping, administration, and business overhead; numeric value: -24000.0; detail: Illustrative recurring allocation equals $2,000 monthly. Combined recurring systems and overhead equal $4,000 monthly, inside the $2,000–$12,000 planning range. File-linked delivery and enforcement costs remain additional.

label: Annual owner net; value: Closing annual owner net profit equals exactly $84,000; numeric value: 84000.0; detail: Closing total is not another cash inflow. The four-person Base pod is 1 FT + 3 C. Canonical comparison: Conservative $60,000 at 20% yields $12,000 with 1 FT + 3 C; Scaled $500,000 at 40% yields $200,000 with 2 FT + 4 C.
